# 3D Scan Metrics

3D Scan Metrics provides high-precision 3D laser scanning, Scan-to-BIM, reverse engineering, and quality inspection services across South Africa.
Primary locations served: Johannesburg, Pretoria, Cape Town, Durban, Port Elizabeth, Sandton, and Centurion.

## Services
- High-Definition 3D Laser Scanning
- Scan-to-BIM Modeling (Autodesk Revit, LOD 200-500)
- Industrial Reverse Engineering
- Quality Inspection

Website: https://www.3dscanmetrics.co.za/
